reason: I already have an aunty's boutique near Hillcroft and a bazaar seller in Sugar Land who know my size and my family. I don't need to drive out to Westheimer for a 15% off opening day when nothing big like Eid is coming up this month.
objection: Westheimer is a drive from where I live, and my usual shop already does alterations and lets me try things on. A new store would have to be clearly better, not just new.
would_change_my_mind: If my friends showed up in Bonita thobes at a wedding or henna night and the embroidery looked better than what my usual shop carries, I'd make the drive to see it.
